description: Needs column 4 (second from the right) to be completely full; it almost never fires otherwise. With column 4 full it is strongest when the player to move is in trouble: the opponent has threat cells stacked in the open columns, so most of my legal moves either sit directly under an opponent winning cell or ignore a must-block. Column 4 full alone, with me safe or winning, gives only weak activation.
effect: Small. When column 4 is already full (the usual firing case), zeroing it changes move probabilities by 3 points or less. Forcing it high where column 4 is still open can suppress column 4, by up to ~49 points in one position (shifted to column 3); elsewhere ~0-6 points. Acts like a 'column 4 unavailable' signal.
notes: Scores: p1 opp-threats 0.106; p2 poisoned column 0.128; p3 col4 full F1 0.238 (recall 0.997, AUROC 0.90); p4 col4 full & opp threats 0.270; p5 col4 full & >=half of my moves lose at 2-ply 0.371 (best); p6 union 0.338; p7 = p5 + graded level 0.371, sim share 0.25. Col 4 full is near-necessary (minimal pair: filling col 4 vs col 6 from same position: 8.7 vs -0.8). Within games, activation alternates with engine value (high when side to move is lost), but there are exceptions (fires with my immediate win available). The grading inside col-4-full positions is only partly explained.
